command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# PATH: aarchbio's image keeps R in /opt/conda/bin, bioconda's x86 one in /usr/local/bin.
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
: > wgcna.log; : > smoke-check.txt; : > modules.tsv
echo "== staged fixture must match its pins =="
sha256sum -c fixture.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the planted-module fixture does not match its pins"; exit 1; }
cat > wgcna.R <<'RSCRIPT'
suppressMessages(library(WGCNA))
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ver <- function(p) tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)), error = function(e) "unknown")
cat(sprintf("version\tWGCNA %s  dynamicTreeCut %s  fastcluster %s  %s\n",
            ver("WGCNA"), ver("dynamicTreeCut"), ver("fastcluster"), R.version.string))
NT <- 2L
enableWGCNAThreads(nThreads = NT)
cat(sprintf("threads\t%s\n", WGCNAnThreads()))

# Tolerances: every exact claim compares two computations of the same quantity in [-1, 1] or
# [0, 1] that differ only in summation order, so 1e-12 is ~4500 machine epsilons of headroom
# and still far tighter than any real disagreement. The 4x4 TOM is dyadic, so it is exact.
out <- character(0); fails <- character(0)
rec <- function(label, ok, detail) {
  line <- sprintf("%-30s %s", label, paste(sapply(detail, as.character), collapse = " "))
  if (!is.na(ok)) line <- paste(line, if (isTRUE(ok)) "  ok" else "  FAIL")
  cat(line, "\n"); out <<- c(out, line)
  if (!is.na(ok) && !isTRUE(ok)) fails <<- c(fails, label)
}
# NaN trap: a one-sided bound passes NaN, so every numeric check goes through this.
le <- function(x, tol) is.finite(x) && x <= tol
ge <- function(x, tol) is.finite(x) && x >= tol

X  <- as.matrix(read.csv("expr.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
XC <- as.matrix(read.csv("control.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
E  <- as.matrix(read.csv("latent.csv", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
lab <- read.delim("labels.tsv")
stopifnot(identical(colnames(X), lab$gene))
rec("matrix", all(dim(X) == c(60, 600)) && all(is.finite(X)), sprintf("%d samples x %d genes", nrow(X), ncol(X)))

ari <- function(a, b) {        # Hubert-Arabie adjusted Rand index from the contingency table
  t <- table(a, b); n <- sum(t); c2 <- function(x) sum(x * (x - 1) / 2)
  s <- c2(t); sa <- c2(rowSums(t)); sb <- c2(colSums(t)); e <- sa * sb / (n * (n - 1) / 2)
  (s - e) / ((sa + sb) / 2 - e)
}

# ---- 1. WGCNA's own cor() vs stats::cor -- two implementations of Pearson
Cw <- WGCNA::cor(X); Cs <- stats::cor(X)
d <- max(abs(Cw - Cs))
rec("cor_vs_stats_cor", le(d, 1e-12), sprintf("max|diff| %.3e  (assert <= 1e-12)", d))

# ---- 2. adjacency closed forms
beta <- 6
Au <- adjacency(X, type = "unsigned", power = beta)
As <- adjacency(X, type = "signed", power = beta)
du <- max(abs(Au - abs(Cs)^beta)); ds <- max(abs(As - ((1 + Cs) / 2)^beta))
rec("adjacency_unsigned", le(du, 1e-12), sprintf("max|A - |cor|^6| %.3e  (assert <= 1e-12)", du))
rec("adjacency_signed", le(ds, 1e-12), sprintf("max|A - ((1+cor)/2)^6| %.3e  (assert <= 1e-12)", ds))

# ---- 3. TOM: a 4-node matrix worked by hand, then the closed form on the full network
H <- matrix(c(1, .5, .5, 0,   .5, 1, .5, 0,   .5, .5, 1, 1,   0, 0, 1, 1), 4, 4)
Thand <- matrix(c(1, .5, .5, .25,  .5, 1, .5, .25,  .5, .5, 1, 1,  .25, .25, 1, 1), 4, 4)
Th <- TOMsimilarity(H, TOMType = "unsigned", verbose = 0)
dh <- max(abs(Th - Thand))
rec("tom_hand_4x4", le(dh, 1e-15), sprintf("max|diff| %.3e vs values worked by hand  (assert <= 1e-15)", dh))
tomclosed <- function(A) {
  A0 <- A; diag(A0) <- 0; k <- rowSums(A0); L <- A0 %*% A0
  T <- (L + A0) / (outer(k, k, pmin) + 1 - A0); diag(T) <- 1; T
}
Tw <- TOMsimilarity(Au, TOMType = "unsigned", verbose = 0)
dt <- max(abs(Tw - tomclosed(Au)))
rec("tom_closed_form_600", le(dt, 1e-12), sprintf("max|diff| %.3e  (assert <= 1e-12)", dt))
# threads: the TOM is the threaded kernel; 1 thread vs 2 must agree exactly before anything is called exact
disableWGCNAThreads(); Tw1 <- TOMsimilarity(Au, TOMType = "unsigned", verbose = 0)
enableWGCNAThreads(nThreads = NT)
rec("tom_1_vs_2_threads", identical(unclass(Tw), unclass(Tw1)), sprintf("identical: %s", identical(unclass(Tw), unclass(Tw1))))

# ---- 4. pickSoftThreshold (observation)
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(X, powerVector = 1:12, verbose = 0)
fi <- sft$fitIndices
r2 <- -sign(fi$slope) * fi$SFT.R.sq
rec("pickSoftThreshold", NA, sprintf("powerEstimate %s; signed R^2 by power 1..12: %s", sft$powerEstimate,
    paste(sprintf("%.3f", r2), collapse = " ")))

# ---- 5. modules: blockwiseModules, twice, then planted truth
bwm <- function(M, type) blockwiseModules(M, power = beta, networkType = type, TOMType = type,
  minModuleSize = 30, maxBlockSize = 5000, mergeCutHeight = 0.25, deepSplit = 2,
  numericLabels = TRUE, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, randomSeed = 12345, saveTOMs = FALSE, verbose = 0)
nu <- bwm(X, "unsigned"); nu2 <- bwm(X, "unsigned")
rec("bwm_two_runs_identical", identical(nu$colors, nu2$colors) && identical(nu$MEs, nu2$MEs),
    sprintf("colors %s, MEs %s", identical(nu$colors, nu2$colors), identical(nu$MEs, nu2$MEs)))
# Planted truth, exactly: every planted module lands whole in ONE detected (non-grey) module, and
# no two planted modules share one. Noise genes may join a module by chance correlation; that is
# reported, not asserted, since 200 random genes at n=60 carry no planted answer.
recovery <- function(planted, got) {
  pm <- sort(setdiff(unique(planted), 0))
  tgt <- sapply(pm, function(p) { g <- unique(got[planted == p]); if (length(g) == 1 && g != 0) g else NA })
  list(ok = all(!is.na(tgt)) && !anyDuplicated(tgt), n = sum(!is.na(tgt)), of = length(pm),
       noise_in = sum(planted == 0 & got != 0), noise = sum(planted == 0))
}
sizes <- function(cl) paste(sort(table(cl[cl != 0]), decreasing = TRUE), collapse = ",")
ru <- recovery(lab$unsigned, nu$colors); nmod <- length(setdiff(unique(nu$colors), 0))
rec("unsigned_modules", nmod == 4, sprintf("%d non-grey, sizes %s  (planted 4 x 100; assert 4)", nmod, sizes(nu$colors)))
rec("unsigned_planted_recovered", ru$ok, sprintf("%d of %d planted modules whole and one-to-one; noise genes absorbed %d of %d; ARI %.4f",
    ru$n, ru$of, ru$noise_in, ru$noise, ari(lab$unsigned, nu$colors)))
ns <- bwm(X, "signed")
rs <- recovery(lab$signed, ns$colors); nsm <- length(setdiff(unique(ns$colors), 0))
rec("signed_modules", nsm == 6, sprintf("%d non-grey, sizes %s  (planted 60+40, 60+40, 100, 100 by sign; assert 6)", nsm, sizes(ns$colors)))
rec("signed_planted_recovered", rs$ok, sprintf("%d of %d sign-split modules whole and one-to-one; noise absorbed %d of %d; ARI %.4f",
    rs$n, rs$of, rs$noise_in, rs$noise, ari(lab$signed, ns$colors)))
rec("signed_splits_anticorrelated", !recovery(lab$unsigned, ns$colors)$ok,
    "the signed network must NOT keep the anticorrelated halves of modules 1-2 together")

# planted eigengenes: each detected ME tracks exactly one latent factor
mes <- nu$MEs[, setdiff(colnames(nu$MEs), "ME0"), drop = FALSE]
R <- abs(stats::cor(mes, E))
best <- apply(R, 1, max); which_ <- apply(R, 1, which.max)
rec("ME_tracks_planted_factor", length(unique(which_)) == 4 && ge(min(best), 0.95),
    sprintf("|cor(ME, E_m)| %s, factors %s  (assert one-to-one, each >= 0.95)",
            paste(sprintf("%.4f", best), collapse = " "), paste(which_, collapse = ",")))

# ---- 6. module eigengene == first PC of the scaled module expression
dmax <- 0
for (m in sort(setdiff(unique(nu$colors), 0))) {
  Z <- scale(X[, nu$colors == m])
  pc <- svd(Z, nu = 1, nv = 0)$u[, 1]
  me <- moduleEigengenes(X, nu$colors)$eigengenes[[paste0("ME", m)]]
  pc <- pc * sign(sum(pc * me))
  dmax <- max(dmax, max(abs(as.numeric(scale(me)) - as.numeric(scale(pc)))))
}
rec("ME_eq_first_PC", le(dmax, 1e-12), sprintf("max|scale(ME) - scale(PC1)| %.3e  (assert <= 1e-12)", dmax))

# ---- 7. control: every gene permuted independently -> no co-expression to find
nc <- bwm(XC, "unsigned")
ac <- ari(lab$unsigned, nc$colors)
ncm <- length(setdiff(unique(nc$colors), 0))
rec("control_ARI", is.finite(ac) && abs(ac) <= 0.05, sprintf("%.4f, %d non-grey modules  (assert |ARI| <= 0.05)", ac, ncm))

write.table(data.frame(gene = colnames(X), planted = lab$unsigned, unsigned = nu$colors, signed = ns$colors, control = nc$colors),
            "modules.tsv", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("digest\tTOM sum %.15e  colors %s\n", sum(Tw), paste(nu$colors[c(1, 101, 201, 301, 401)], collapse = ",")))
out <- c(out, sprintf("arch                           %s (R_ARCH %s)", Sys.info()[["machine"]], R.version$arch))
if (length(fails)) { out <- c(out, paste("FAILED:", paste(fails, collapse = ", "))); writeLines(out, "smoke-check.txt"); quit(status = 1) }
out <- c(out, "WGCNA OK"); writeLines(out, "smoke-check.txt")
RSCRIPT
T0=$(date +%s)
Rscript wgcna.R > wgcna.log 2>&1; RC=$?
echo "Rscript rc $RC in $(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))s"
cat wgcna.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a WGCNA check failed (see smoke-check.txt / wgcna.log)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "^WGCNA OK$" smoke-check.txt || { echo "FAIL: smoke check did not complete"; exit 1; }
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
